findings.finding: The explanation introduces e as the program index but writes the returned program as s^m_n(x,...), and the following tagged sentence likewise says to regard x as the machine description before reverting to e in the formula.
findings.controlling_evidence: The theorem statement and the same tagged explanation consistently apply s^m_n to the index e and fixed inputs a_0 through a_{m-1}.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use e as the program or machine-description index throughout and add an adjacent OLTECOMTHY-001 disclosure.

findings.finding: The opening sentence calls the previously constructed partial computable function total for the partial computable functions, where the contrast and following theorem require universal for them.
findings.controlling_evidence: The preceding section proves that Un is universal and partial; the following theorem denies a total computable function universal for all total computable functions.
findings.required_translation_handling: State that the partial function is universal for the partial computable functions and add an adjacent OLTECOMTHY-002 disclosure.

findings.finding: The parenthesis says h can take value zero only if h is defined, although h is assumed computable and hence total; the needed implication is that g is defined only when h(x,x)=0.
findings.controlling_evidence: The immediately preceding cases define g(x)=0 when h(x,x)=0 and leave g(x) undefined otherwise.
findings.required_translation_handling: Attribute the definedness condition to g, not h, and add an adjacent OLTECOMTHY-003 disclosure.

findings.finding: After defining S={x:x not-in x}, the source writes S in S iff X not-in S with an undefined capital X.
findings.controlling_evidence: Substituting S into its defining membership condition gives S in S iff S not-in S, which is the stated Russell contradiction.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use S not-in S and add an adjacent OLTECOMTHY-004 disclosure.

findings.finding: The full section title misspells Definitions as Defininitions.
findings.controlling_evidence: The short title uses the correct spelling and the section proves equivalent definitions.
findings.required_translation_handling: Translate the correctly spelled title and add an adjacent OLTECOMTHY-005 disclosure.

findings.finding: From T(e,(z)_0,(z)_1) and U((z)_1)=y the source concludes cfind_e(x) is defined and equals y, but x is not bound in that reverse-direction case.
findings.controlling_evidence: The normal-form equation applied to the displayed computation code yields cfind_e((z)_0)=U((z)_1)=y.
findings.required_translation_handling: Use (z)_0 as the argument of cfind_e and add an adjacent OLTECOMTHY-006 disclosure.
